newsitem.title: UK: European bunker prices rise ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: European bunker prices rise ahead of holiday.

text.p: Bunker fuel prices rose in Europe on Thursday as suppliers raised their offers ahead of Assumption Day holidays in northwest European and Mediterranean countries, brokers and traders said.
"There has been quite a dramatic rise in some places," one dealer said. "It is localised to Europe as there is a holiday in the Catholic countries. Suppliers are trying to hike their prices up."
Delivered prices for 380 cst bunkers in Rotterdam were a couple of dollars firmer at around $99 a tonne. Bunker supplies in the prompt period were tight, too.
Diesel oil and gas oil prices were also firmer as IPE gas oil futures gained another three to four dollars.
Prices for 380 cst material in Antwerp were also a dollar or two stronger while those in Fujairah were talked up at around $105/$106, a gain of some $5 from the beginning of the week.
